shifts.summary: The paper was reported overall as Easy to Moderate, with some candidates rating it Moderate. Candidates said they attempted well on about 65–75 questions in total. Reasoning was seen as easy by some and moderate to difficult by others, while GK was easy for some and difficult for others. Quant was described as moderate to difficult or difficult, with time pressure noted. English was generally easy, though a few found it moderate to difficult.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Reasoning was described as easy, normal and doable in 10‑11 minutes.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: GK was factual, easy, with one economics question and current‑affairs from 2025.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Math felt lengthy; time pressure of 15 min, candidates could attempt 15‑16 questions, up to 20 if fast.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: English had 3‑4 synonym‑antonym, 2 one‑word substitutions, 2 idioms and one passage; described as easy.

asked.q: When did the Women's Fish Cup take place?

observations: First shift considered easy, other shifts tougher.
Time pressure was a common concern, especially in Math.
Overall paper considered moderate by candidates.
Poll involved ~70 candidates out of ~2000 responses.
disagreements: Overall difficulty split between Easy to Moderate and Moderate.
Reasoning split between Easy and Moderate to Difficult.
GA split between Easy and Difficult.
Quant and English both split, with Quant ranging Moderate to Difficult vs Difficult and English Easy vs Moderate to Difficult.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 23 October 2026 has an unofficial, partial analysis for Shift 1. Candidates reported the paper as ranging from Easy to Moderate overall, with mixed views on individual sections. No usable analysis is available yet for Shifts 2 and 3, and further candidate evidence is required before publishing. All figures mentioned are unofficial, and SSC normalises scores across shifts.

faqs.q: What is the overall difficulty level reported for the 23 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1 Shift 1?
faqs.a: Shift 1 is described as Easy to Moderate overall, though some candidates rated it as Moderate. The assessment is based on limited reports and should be considered provisional.

faqs.q: Why are there no figures for the number of well‑attempted questions on 23 October 2026 Shift 1?
faqs.a: The reported range of well‑attempted questions (65–75) comes from candidate feedback and is not verified by official sources, so it is omitted from the analysis.
